poems.original_poem:
बोडो ग्वसिंग
बोडो ग्वसिंग, तुमार धुन
संगीत भरी गुथा,
मोर मनत ठोर ठोर
सपना गितार उठी।
poems.translated_poem:
Bodo Song
Bodo Gwsing, your tune
Woven with music,
In my heart, every beat
Dreams rise like melodies.

poems.original_poem:
फुल ग्वसिंग
फुल ग्वसिंग, तुमार सुगंध
मोन गुथा, हृदय भरि,
मोर सपना गितार
संगीत गुनगुन।
poems.translated_poem:
Flower Song
Flower song, your fragrance
Weaves in my heart,
In my dreams,
Melodies hum.

poems.original_poem:
कोकराजहार
कोकराजहार, तुमार माटि
धुन शान्ति, मोर स्वप्न,
मोर हृदय माटित
जीवन बरजारी।
poems.translated_poem:
Kokrajhar
Kokrajhar, your soil
Sings of peace, my dream,
In my heart’s earth
Life flows beautifully.

poems.original_poem:
बोडो राखंग
बोडो राखंग, तुमार पहिचान
संस्कृति, धरोहर, मोर गर्व,
मोर हृदयले गुनगुन
जन्मभूमि जिवित।
poems.translated_poem:
Bodo Identity
Bodo Identity, your recognition
Culture, heritage, my pride,
In my heart, a hum
Of my birthplace alive.

poems.original_poem:
धर्म
धर्म, तुमार मार्ग
जीवनले सिखावै,
मोर हृदयले बिचार
सत्य गुथा।
poems.translated_poem:
Religion
Religion, your path
Teaches life,
In my heart, thoughts
Woven with truth.
